reason: The domain sensitivity check is INCONCLUSIVE because R1 is not statistically reliable (Cd ci95 0.10446, drift_rel 0.27794, 80 convective units only). It also tests whether the large R0-R1 differences are start-up artefacts or real boundary effects.
